Name: Nox's Goblin Henchman Replacement
Author: noxscarlet
Description:
[center]
[b][size=4]Nox's Goblin Henchman Replacement[/size][/b]
[size=3]
Are you looking for a cuter (and less stereotypical) alternative for the Witch's Goblin Henchman? Look no further! 
I wanted to give our Henchman friend a slightly less cartoonish look, more human-like features, a more toned-down recolor, and shoes for his sprites. (Why was he barefoot??)

[/size][size=3]As far as I know, this mod should be compatible with other portrait/sprite replacements! This is my first mod, so please let me know if any errors occur. [/size][/center]
